recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-21005; future detailed questionnaire/library guidance belongs in SDC or the Extension Pack unless the work groups request a specific core cross-reference.
issue_request: FHIR-21005 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for R5 asking to withdraw CQIF Questionnaire because the R4 profile only pointed to a CQL library, lacked usable population guidance, and had a technically incorrect example.
initial_application: Commit bc30255627a58b5e899f1afd7a087806ab48ac23, explicitly tagged J#30204 and J#21005, removed the CQF/CQIF Questionnaire StructureDefinition, ImplementationGuide, notes, PHQ-9 example, Questionnaire example entry, and Questionnaire pack entry, and changed Clinical Reasoning documentation to point users to Structured Data Capture.
additional_context: FHIR-30204 is the later same-change-family issue. FHIR-20411 records the broader SDC/CQF harmonization decision, including migration of the CQF example to SDC. A 2018 Zulip thread shows CQIF Questionnaire behavior/external data retrieval questions were already expected to converge with SDC work.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current core source has no active CQF/CQIF Questionnaire profile or example remnants and the active Clinical Reasoning documentation routes users to SDC.

related_jiras.note: Later Published request to eliminate CQF Questionnaire, applied in the same source commit.
Upstream harmonization decision to move CQF questionnaire population guidance/example work to SDC.
